```{r, include=FALSE}
# --- Consolidated Libraries ---
library(tidyverse)

library(biomaRt)
library(dplyr)

library(gplots)
library(sva)
library(DESeq2)
library(ggrepel)
library(tximport)
library(pheatmap)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(ggvenn)
```


```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 1. CREATE METADATA
# ============================================================================
cat("Step 1: Creating metadata from SRA information...\n")

metadata <- data.frame(
  Run = c("SRR11256286", "SRR11256287", "SRR11256288", "SRR11256289", 
          "SRR11256290", "SRR11256291", "SRR11256373", "SRR11256374",
          "SRR11256375", "SRR11256376", "SRR11256377", "SRR11256378"),
  Sample.Name = c("SAMN14322546", "SAMN14322545", "SAMN14322544", "SAMN14322543",
                  "SAMN14322542", "SAMN14322541", "SAMN14322680", "SAMN14322679",
                  "SAMN14322678", "SAMN14322677", "SAMN14322676", "SAMN14322675"),
  Organ = c("Brain", "Brain", "Brain", "Brain", "Brain", "Brain",
            "Liver", "Liver", "Liver", "Liver", "Liver", "Liver"),
  Condition = c("LCMVd8", "LCMVd8", "LCMVd8", "steady_state", "steady_state", "steady_state",
                "LCMVd8", "LCMVd8", "LCMVd8", "steady_state", "steady_state", "steady_state"),
  cell_type = rep("GP38negCD31pos", 12),
  GEO_Accession = c("GSM4395838", "GSM4395839", "GSM4395840", "GSM4395841",
                    "GSM4395842", "GSM4395843", "GSM4395925", "GSM4395926",
                    "GSM4395927", "GSM4395928", "GSM4395929", "GSM4395930")
)

write.table(metadata, file = "SraRunTable.txt", 
            sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

cat(sprintf("✓ Created metadata for %d samples\n", nrow(metadata)))


```


```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 2. IMPORT RSEM QUANTIFICATION DATA
# ============================================================================
cat("\nStep 2: Loading RSEM quantification data...\n")

sample_ids <- metadata$Run

expr <- sapply(sample_ids, function(sample_id){
  file <- file.path("rsem", sample_id, paste0(sample_id, ".genes.results"))
  if (!file.exists(file)) {
    warning(sprintf("File not found: %s", file))
    return(NA)
  }
  quant <- read.csv(file, sep="\t", header=TRUE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  tpm <- setNames(quant$TPM, quant$gene_id)
  return(tpm)
})

colnames(expr) <- sample_ids
meta <- metadata # Use 'meta' as the clean metadata object
cat(sprintf("✓ Loaded expression data: %d genes x %d samples\n", nrow(expr), ncol(expr)))

```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 3. GET GENE ANNOTATIONS FROM ENSEMBL
# ============================================================================
cat("\nStep 3: Getting gene annotations from Ensembl...\n")

original_gene_ids <- rownames(expr)
cat(sprintf("Mapping %d UniProt IDs (e.g., %s)...\n", 
            length(original_gene_ids), original_gene_ids[1]))

ensembl <- useEnsembl(biomart = "ensembl", dataset = "mmusculus_gene_ensembl")

meta_genes <- getBM(
  attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "mgi_symbol", "description", 
                 "chromosome_name", "start_position", "end_position", 
                 "strand", "uniprot_gn_id"),
  filters = "uniprot_gn_id",
  values = original_gene_ids,
  mart = ensembl
)

cat(sprintf("Retrieved annotations for %d gene entries\n", nrow(meta_genes)))

if (nrow(meta_genes) == 0) {
  warning("No genes found. Check your UniProt IDs and mart connection.")
  meta_genes <- data.frame(uniprot_gn_id = original_gene_ids)
} else {
  meta_genes <- meta_genes %>%
    right_join(data.frame(uniprot_gn_id = original_gene_ids), by = "uniprot_gn_id") %>%
    distinct(uniprot_gn_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

# Reorder expression matrix to match gene metadata
expr <- expr[meta_genes$uniprot_gn_id, ]
rownames(meta_genes) <- meta_genes$uniprot_gn_id
cat(sprintf("✓ Final metadata table has %d entries\n", nrow(meta_genes)))


```


```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 4. FILTER LOW-EXPRESSION GENES
# ============================================================================
cat("\nStep 4: Filtering low-expression genes...\n")

num_samples_detected <- rowSums(expr > 0)
avg_tpm <- rowMeans(expr)

# Keep genes detected in at least 50% of samples OR average TPM >= 1
keep_genes <- (num_samples_detected >= (ncol(expr) / 2)) | (avg_tpm >= 1)

cat(sprintf("  Initial gene count: %d\n", nrow(expr)))
cat(sprintf("  Kept %d 'expressed' genes\n", sum(keep_genes)))

# Create new filtered data frames
expr_filtered <- expr[keep_genes, ]
meta_genes_filtered <- meta_genes[keep_genes, ]

cat(sprintf("✓ Created filtered matrix: %d genes x %d samples\n", 
            nrow(expr_filtered), ncol(expr_filtered)))


```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 5. POST-FILTERING DATA EXPLORATION
# ============================================================================
cat("\nStep 5: Plotting post-filtering expression distribution...\n")

plot_data <- data.frame(avg_tpm = rowMeans(expr_filtered))

# ggplot histogram with log-transformed axes
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = avg_tpm)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log1p", 
                     breaks = c(0, 1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000)) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log1p") +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Average Gene Expression (Filtered)",
       x = "Average TPM (Log10 Scale)",
       y = "Number of Genes (Log10 Scale)") +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 6. SAMPLE CORRELATION & HEATMAP
# ============================================================================
cat("\nStep 6: Calculating sample correlations and plotting heatmap...\n")

# Spearman correlation on ranks (no log-transform needed)
corr_spearman <- cor(expr_filtered, method = "spearman")

# Hierarchical clustering
hcl_spearman <- hclust(as.dist(1 - corr_spearman))

# Create custom labels for heatmap
custom_labels <- paste(meta$Organ, meta$Condition, sep = "_")

# Create the heatmap
heatmap.2(corr_spearman,
          Rowv = as.dendrogram(hcl_spearman), 
          Colv = as.dendrogram(hcl_spearman), 
          col = viridis(100),                 
          main = "Sample Correlation (Spearman)",
          trace = "none",                     
          margins = c(8, 8),                  
          labRow = custom_labels,
          labCol = custom_labels,
          cexRow = 0.8,                       
          cexCol = 0.8
)
cat("✓ Correlation heatmap generated.\n")

```


```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 7. PRINCIPAL COMPONENT ANALYSIS (PCA) - BEFORE CORRECTION
# ============================================================================
cat("\nStep 7: Running PCA before batch correction...\n")

# Run PCA on log-transformed, filtered data
# Samples must be rows, so we transpose with t()
pca <- prcomp(log1p(t(expr_filtered)), center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

# Combine PCA coordinates with metadata for plotting
pca_data <- data.frame(pca$x, meta)

# Create the PCA scatter plot
ggplot(pca_data, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Condition, shape = Organ)) +
  geom_point(size = 5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "PCA Before Batch Correction",
       subtitle = "Samples cluster strongly by 'Organ' (shape)",
       x = "Principal Component 1 (PC1)",
       y = "Principal Component 2 (PC2)")

cat("✓ Pre-correction PCA plot generated.\n")


```


```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 8. BATCH EFFECT CORRECTION (ComBat)
# ============================================================================
cat("\nStep 8: Running Batch Effect Correction (ComBat)...\n")

# Run ComBat using 'Organ' as the batch variable
# We use the log-transformed filtered data
expr_combat <- ComBat(dat = log1p(expr_filtered), 
                      batch = meta$Organ, 
                      mod = NULL,
                      par.prior = TRUE, 
                      prior.plots = FALSE)

cat("✓ Batch correction complete. New matrix 'expr_combat' created.\n")

```



```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 9. PCA - AFTER CORRECTION
# ============================================================================
cat("\nStep 9: Running PCA on corrected data...\n")

# Run PCA on the batch-corrected data (already log-scale)
pca_combat <- prcomp(t(expr_combat), center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

# Combine corrected PCA data with metadata
pca_combat_data <- data.frame(pca_combat$x, meta)

# Plot the new PCA
ggplot(pca_combat_data, 
       aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Condition, shape = Organ)) +
  geom_point(size = 5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "PCA After ComBat Correction",
       subtitle = "Samples now group by 'Condition' (color)",
       x = "Principal Component 1 (PC1)",
       y = "Principal Component 2 (PC2)")

cat("✓ Corrected PCA plot generated.\n")


```


```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 10. LOAD ISOFORM DATA WITH TXIMPORT FOR DESEQ2
# ============================================================================
cat("\nStep 10: Loading isoform data with tximport for DESeq2...\n")

# Get the list of file paths
files <- file.path("rsem", sample_ids, paste0(sample_ids, ".isoforms.results"))
names(files) <- sample_ids

# --- CREATE THE TX2GENE MAP ---
cat("Building the transcript-to-gene map (tx2gene)...\n")

# Get transcript IDs from one file
first_file <- read.csv(files[1], sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
all_transcript_ids <- first_file$transcript_id

# Query biomaRt to map Ensembl Transcript IDs to UniProt Gene IDs
tx2gene_map <- getBM(
  attributes = c("ensembl_transcript_id_version", # Col 1: Transcript ID
                 "uniprot_gn_id"),                # Col 2: Gene ID
  filters = "ensembl_transcript_id_version",
  values = all_transcript_ids,
  mart = ensembl
)

# Clean the map
tx2gene_map_clean <- tx2gene_map %>%
  filter(!is.na(uniprot_gn_id) & uniprot_gn_id != "" &
           !is.na(ensembl_transcript_id_version) & ensembl_transcript_id_version != "") %>%
  distinct(ensembl_transcript_id_version, .keep_all = TRUE)

cat(sprintf("✓ Map created: %d transcripts mapped to %d unique genes.\n", 
            nrow(tx2gene_map_clean), n_distinct(tx2gene_map_clean$uniprot_gn_id)))

# --- RUN TXIMPORT ---
txi <- tximport(files, 
                type = "rsem", 
                tx2gene = tx2gene_map_clean)

cat("✓ Raw count data loaded and summarized to gene level in 'txi' object.\n")


```


```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 11. CREATE FILTER FOR DESEQ2
# ============================================================================
cat("\nStep 11: Creating 'expressed' gene filter for DESeq2...\n")

# Use the abundance (TPM) matrix from the 'txi' object
abundances <- txi$abundance

# Keep genes with TPM >= 1 OR detected in >= 50% of samples
keep_genes_deseq <- (rowMeans(abundances > 0) >= 0.5) | (rowMeans(abundances) >= 1)

cat(sprintf("✓ DESeq2 filter created, keeping %d genes.\n", sum(keep_genes_deseq)))


```


```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 12. RUN DIFFERENTIAL EXPRESSION ANALYSES
# ============================================================================
cat("\nStep 12: Running All DESeq2 Analyses...\n")

# 1. Create the base DDS object
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromTximport(txi,
                                colData = meta,
                                design = ~ Organ + Condition)

# 2. Filter for expressed genes (from Step 11)
dds_filtered <- dds[keep_genes_deseq, ]

# 3. ANALYSIS 1: Organ Effect
# Test: Full model (~ Organ + Condition) vs. Reduced (~ Condition)
cat("  Running Analysis 1: Organ Effect...\n")
design(dds_filtered) <- ~ Organ + Condition
dds_org <- DESeq(dds_filtered, test = "LRT", reduced = ~ Condition)
res_org <- results(dds_org)
res_org <- res_org[order(res_org$padj), ]
cat(sprintf("  ✓ Found %d significant genes for Organ effect (padj < 0.1)\n",
            sum(res_org$padj < 0.1, na.rm=TRUE)))

# 4. ANALYSIS 2: Condition Effect
# Test: Full model (~ Organ + Condition) vs. Reduced (~ Organ)
cat("  Running Analysis 2: Condition Effect...\n")
design(dds_filtered) <- ~ Organ + Condition
dds_cond <- DESeq(dds_filtered, test = "LRT", reduced = ~ Organ)
res_cond <- results(dds_cond)
res_cond <- res_cond[order(res_cond$padj), ]
cat(sprintf("  ✓ Found %d significant genes for Condition effect (padj < 0.1)\n",
            sum(res_cond$padj < 0.1, na.rm=TRUE)))

# 5. ANALYSIS 3: Interaction Effect
# Test: Full model (~ Organ + Condition + Organ:Condition) vs. Reduced (~ Organ + Condition)
cat("  Running Analysis 3: Interaction Effect...\n")
design(dds_filtered) <- ~ Organ + Condition + Organ:Condition
dds_int <- DESeq(dds_filtered, test = "LRT", reduced = ~ Organ + Condition)
res_int <- results(dds_int)
res_int <- res_int[order(res_int$padj), ]
cat(sprintf("  ✓ Found %d significant genes for Interaction effect (padj < 0.1)\n",
            sum(res_int$padj < 0.1, na.rm=TRUE)))

cat("\n✓ All DESeq2 analyses complete.\n")

```


```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 13. COMPARE ANALYSIS RESULTS
# ============================================================================
cat("\nStep 13: Comparing analysis results...\n")

# 1. Define significant genes (padj < 0.1)
padj_thresh <- 0.1
sig_genes_org <- rownames(subset(res_org, padj < padj_thresh))
sig_genes_cond <- rownames(subset(res_cond, padj < padj_thresh))
sig_genes_int <- rownames(subset(res_int, padj < padj_thresh))

cat(sprintf("Total Significant Genes (padj < %.2f):\n", padj_thresh))
cat(sprintf("  - Organ Effect:     %d\n", length(sig_genes_org)))
cat(sprintf("  - Condition Effect: %d\n", length(sig_genes_cond)))
cat(sprintf("  - Interaction Effect: %d\n", length(sig_genes_int)))

# 2. Create a list for the Venn diagram
gene_lists <- list(
  Organ = sig_genes_org,
  Condition = sig_genes_cond,
  Interaction = sig_genes_int
)

# 3. Generate the Venn diagram
ggvenn(
  gene_lists,
  fill_color = c("#0073C2FF", "#EFC000FF", "#CD534CFF"),
  stroke_size = 0.5,
  set_name_size = 4,
  text_size = 3,
  show_percentage = FALSE
) +
labs(title = "Overlap of Significant Genes (padj < 0.1) Across Analyses")

cat("\n✓ Venn diagram generated.\n")


```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 14. VOLCANO PLOT (ANALYSIS 2: CONDITION EFFECT)
# ============================================================================
cat("\nStep 14: Generating Volcano Plot for Condition Effect...\n")

# Extract the specific LFC of "steady_state" vs. "LCMVd8"
# We use the 'dds_cond' object here
res_contrast_cond <- results(dds_cond, 
                             name = "Condition_steady_state_vs_LCMVd8")

# Convert results to a data.frame for ggplot
res_df_cond <- as.data.frame(res_contrast_cond)

# Merge with gene metadata to get gene symbols
plot_data_cond <- merge(res_df_cond, meta_genes, by = 0)
colnames(plot_data_cond)[colnames(plot_data_cond) == "Row.names"] <- "gene_id"

# Create new columns for plotting
padj_threshold <- 0.1
logfc_threshold <- 1.0 

plot_data_cond <- plot_data_cond %>%
  mutate(
    significance = case_when(
      padj < padj_threshold & log2FoldChange > logfc_threshold  ~ "Up-regulated in steady_state",
      padj < padj_threshold & log2FoldChange < -logfc_threshold ~ "Down-regulated in steady_state",
      TRUE ~ "Not Significant"
    ),
    gene_label = if_else(significance != "Not Significant", mgi_symbol, NA_character_)
  )

# Create the Volcano Plot
ggplot(plot_data_cond, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj))) +
  geom_point(aes(color = significance), alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = gene_label), max.overlaps = 15) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Up-regulated in steady_state" = "red", 
                                "Down-regulated in steady_state" = "blue", 
                                "Not Significant" = "grey")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-logfc_threshold, logfc_threshold), linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(padj_threshold), linetype = "dotted") +
  labs(title = "Volcano Plot: Condition Effect",
       subtitle = "steady_state vs. LCMVd8 (avg. across Organs)",
       x = "log2(Fold Change)",
       y = "-log10(Adjusted P-value)") +
  theme_minimal()

cat("✓ Condition effect volcano plot generated.\n")

```


```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 15. VOLCANO PLOT (ANALYSIS 3: INTERACTION EFFECT)
# ============================================================================
cat("\nStep 15: Generating Volcano Plot for Interaction Effect...\n")

# Use the results from our 'res_int' object
res_df_interaction <- as.data.frame(res_int)

# Merge with gene metadata
plot_data_interaction <- merge(res_df_interaction, meta_genes, by = 0)
colnames(plot_data_interaction)[colnames(plot_data_interaction) == "Row.names"] <- "gene_id"

# Create new columns for plotting
plot_data_interaction <- plot_data_interaction %>%
  mutate(
    significant_interaction = if_else(padj < padj_threshold, "Significant", "Not Significant"),
    gene_label = if_else(significant_interaction == "Significant", mgi_symbol, NA_character_)
  )

# Create the Volcano Plot
ggplot(plot_data_interaction, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj))) +
  geom_point(aes(color = significant_interaction), alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = gene_label), max.overlaps = 15) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Significant" = "darkgreen", 
                                "Not Significant" = "grey")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(padj_threshold), linetype = "dotted") +
  labs(title = "Volcano Plot: Interaction Effect (Organ:Condition)",
       subtitle = "Genes that respond *differently* to infection in Brain vs. Liver",
       x = "log2(Interaction Effect)",
       y = "-log10(Adjusted P-value)") +
  theme_minimal()

cat("✓ Interaction effect volcano plot generated.\n")


```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 16. HEATMAP OF SIGNIFICANT GENES (from Condition Effect)
# ============================================================================
cat("\nStep 16: Extracting significant genes and normalizing data...\n")

# Get significant gene IDs from our "Condition Effect" results (res_cond)
res_cond_df <- as.data.frame(res_cond)
sig_genes <- subset(res_cond_df, 
                    padj < padj_threshold & abs(log2FoldChange) > logfc_threshold)
sig_gene_ids <- rownames(sig_genes)

cat(sprintf("✓ Found %d significant genes (padj < %.2f & LFC > %.1f).\n", 
            length(sig_gene_ids), padj_threshold, logfc_threshold))

# Get variance-stabilized normalized data from the 'dds_cond' object
vsd <- vst(dds_cond, blind = FALSE)

# Subset normalized data to include ONLY our significant genes
sig_vst_data <- assay(vsd)[sig_gene_ids, ]

cat("✓ Created 'sig_vst_data' matrix for heatmap.\n")


```


```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 17. GENERATE HEATMAP
# ============================================================================
cat("\nStep 17: Generating heatmap of significant genes...\n")

# Create an annotation data frame for the columns (samples)
sample_annotation <- data.frame(
  Condition = meta$Condition,
  Organ = meta$Organ
)
rownames(sample_annotation) <- meta$Run

# Create the heatmap
pheatmap(
  sig_vst_data,
  main = "Heatmap of Significant DEGs (Condition Effect)",
  color = viridis(100),
  annotation_col = sample_annotation,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  scale = "row" # Scale by gene (Z-score)
)

cat("✓ Heatmap generated.\n")

```



```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 18. PREPARE GENE LISTS FOR GO ANALYSIS
# ============================================================================
cat("\nStep 18: Preparing gene lists for GO Analysis...\n")

# Get significant UniProt IDs (from Condition Effect)
sig_uniprot_ids <- sig_gene_ids

# Get "universe" (all expressed genes from our DESeq2 filter)
# We can use the 'dds_cond' object as it's already filtered
universe_uniprot_ids <- rownames(dds_cond)

# Convert UniProt IDs to Entrez IDs
cat("Converting UniProt IDs to Entrez IDs...\n")
id_map <- bitr(universe_uniprot_ids, 
               fromType = "UNIPROT",
               toType = "ENTREZID",
               OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db)

# Create final gene lists using Entrez IDs
sig_entrez_ids <- id_map$ENTREZID[id_map$UNIPROT %in% sig_uniprot_ids]
universe_entrez_ids <- id_map$ENTREZID

cat(sprintf("✓ Mapped %d significant genes and %d universe genes to Entrez IDs.\n",
            length(sig_entrez_ids), length(universe_entrez_ids)))

```


```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 19. RUN GO ENRICHMENT ANALYSIS
# ============================================================================
cat("\nStep 19: Running GO Enrichment Analysis...\n")

go_results <- enrichGO(
  gene = sig_entrez_ids,
  universe = universe_entrez_ids,
  OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db,
  ont = "BP", # Biological Process
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  qvalueCutoff = 0.1,
  readable = TRUE # Converts Entrez IDs back to Gene Symbols
)

cat("✓ GO Analysis complete.\n")

cat("\n--- Top GO Enrichment Results (Biological Process) ---\n")
print(head(as.data.frame(go_results)))


```


```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 20. VISUALIZE GO RESULTS
# ============================================================================
cat("\nStep 20: Generating GO results dot plot...\n")

# Dot plot of top 15 terms
dotplot(go_results, showCategory = 15) + 
  labs(title = "Top 15 Enriched GO Terms (Biological Process)")

cat("✓ GO dot plot generated.\n")

```
